desktop.text: MediVault. Every prescription, lab report and bill your family has been handed — in one place, read and searchable.
Adding a page is one sheet. The date and the doctor are optional, because it reads them off the photo.
Checked on the device. A vision model reads the page; a language model gives it structure.
What comes back is a record, not a wall of text. Doctor, hospital, diagnosis, and every medicine with its dose.
Everything from one visit stays together. The whole history, newest first — nothing filed by hand.
One account holds the family. Each person keeps their own timeline, never under the wrong name.
Find any of it by doctor, medicine, diagnosis or year — including the prescription uploaded a minute ago.
And a page it cannot read says so, and keeps your original.
MediVault. The same app on a phone and on a desktop.
